throughline.zh: 半導體與資料中心供應鏈本週公布在台載板、封裝、設備研發及廠務擴充，也揭露實際伺服器收入、冷卻設計規格與新的晶片管制立場。
throughline.en: This week brought Taiwan substrate, packaging, equipment R&D and facilities expansion plans, alongside reported server revenue, cooling specifications and new chip-control positions.

title.zh: 先進封裝、晶圓製程設備與資安驗證
title.en: Advanced packaging, wafer equipment and cybersecurity

summary.zh: 精材、日月光、漢測與旺矽等企業此前披露封裝、設備或產能進度。輝達 11 月 17 日新增景碩幼獅載板協議及矽品先進封裝擴充，科林 11 月 18 日竹南技術中心動土；相關倍數與啟用日期均是未來目標。
summary.en: Earlier stories covered Xintec, ASE, Hermes and WinWay in packaging and test. NVIDIA added Kinsus substrate and SPIL packaging agreements, and Lam Research broke ground in Zhunan on November 18. Capacity multipliers and opening dates remain targets.

title.zh: 機櫃電源、液冷與伺服器整機展示
title.en: Rack power, liquid cooling and server-system demonstrations

summary.zh: 技嘉、光寶科及貝爾威勒先前公布伺服器、電源和互連產品進度，SC26 亦展示液冷機櫃。其曜 11 月 18 日新增最高 200kW 機櫃冷卻規格；該值屬產品宣稱，尚無具名客戶驗收。
summary.en: Gigabyte, Lite-On and Bellwether reported server, power and interconnect developments, alongside SC26 rack exhibits. Chiyau added a 200kW cooling design specification November 18, without customer qualification records.

title.zh: 記憶體供應、SSD 控制與工廠營運
title.en: Memory supply, SSD controllers and plant operations

summary.zh: 模組業者與大聯大說明記憶體供貨和營收結構，美光施工事故停工限於施工工區。輝達 FY2027 第三季資料中心營收達 1,076 億美元，Vera Rubin 已開始出貨，但台灣供應商個別機櫃數仍未公布。
summary.en: Memory module makers and WPG discussed supply mix, while Micron's incident affected a construction zone. NVIDIA reported US$107.6bn in FY2027 Q3 data-center sales and Vera Rubin shipments, without Taiwan supplier-specific rack counts.

title.zh: 製程感測、儲能 PCS 與工廠供電
title.en: Process sensors, PCS storage and factory power

summary.zh: 日月光感測器採購、燿華儲能工程與熙特爾 PCS 合作計畫屬不同執行階段。漢科 11 月 18 日公布在手廠務工程訂單 150 億元，未披露逐專案履約收入與驗收。
summary.en: ASE's sensor orders, Unitech's battery project and Xitel's PCS memorandum represent separate commercial stages. Hanke reported NT$15bn backlog on November 18 without project-level revenue recognition or acceptance.

title.zh: 國際晶片管制、資本流向與終端製造
title.en: International chip controls, capital flows and end-use manufacturing

summary.zh: 經濟部此前公布前十月投資核准統計，美國 BIS 新規及鴻海 Sony 車載相機交易仍待各自後續程序。新加坡副總理 11 月 18 日回應美國晶片管制，表示正與企業評估規範影響；目前沒有可核實的資料中心停工數量。
summary.en: MOEA previously published investment approvals, while U.S. BIS controls and Foxconn's Sony transaction await separate procedural milestones. Singapore's deputy prime minister responded November 18 that authorities were consulting firms, without quantified data-center disruptions.
